description: Welcome to TerraNova! I'm a Python and Data Science enthusiast from Pakistan with experience in Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, data cleaning, EDA, statistics, data visualization, APIs, and machine learning. My strengths include analytical thinking, problem-solving, identifying patterns in datasets, and turning data into meaningful insights. Join us to combine technology, AI, and agricultural innovation, share your expertise, explore new ideas, and build a solution.
